import os

code='''def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    # Extend the vertical edge colors across the interior below the horizontal 5-bar.
    top=next((r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if 5 in row),0)
    left5=[c for c,v in enumerate(grid[top]) if v==5]
    if left5:
        end=max(left5)
        for r in range(top+1,h):
            seed=grid[r][0]
            if seed not in (0,5):
                for c in range(1,end+1): out[r][c]=seed
    # Extend the horizontal pattern at the foot of the vertical 5-bar upward.
    bars=[c for c in range(w) if sum(grid[r][c]==5 for r in range(h))>=2]
    if bars:
        c=bars[-1]
        rows=[r for r in range(h) if grid[r][c]==5]
        last=max(rows)
        seeds=[r for r in range(last+1,h) if any(grid[r][j] not in (0,5) for j in range(c+1,w))]
        if seeds:
            pattern=[[grid[r][j] for j in range(c+1,w)] for r in seeds]
            start=min(rows)+1
            for r in range(start,last+1):
                pr=(r-start)%len(pattern)
                for j,val in enumerate(pattern[pr],c+1): out[r][j]=val
    return out
'''
